title: Matthew 24:26-29: as in the days of Noah, so the Son of Man
summary: Matthew 24:26-29 header (English and Greek) with the verses numbered 26 and 27: as it happened in the days of Noah, so it will be in the days of the Son of Man; people were eating, drinking and marrying until Noah entered the ark and the flood destroyed them all. The "No" of Noah is highlighted in green.

text.text: 26 “And just as it happened in the days of Noah, so it will be also in the days of the Son of Man:
27 they were eating, they were drinking, they were marrying, they were being given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered the ark, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

keywords: as in the days of Noah
uncertain: The header and verse numbers read Matthew 24:26-29 and 26-27, but the wording matches the passage normally numbered Luke 17:26-27; transcribed as shown.
